name: Jewel of Clementia
detailed_description:
One day you meet a woman who is collecting artifacts. On the artifacts there are many unfamiliar characters written. She says that to decipher the characters, she needs mana. According to her research, the characters are written in a foreign language called Japanese and if you decipher the characters on the artifacts, they will lead you to the Jewel of Clementia. Since you know how to collect mana, you get interested and decide to collect artifacts and decipher the characters. Now your journey will begin.

Jewel of Clementia is a puzzle solving visual novel game where players actually learn the Japanese language. Players collect artifacts and manas and decipher the characters on the artifacts. The characters are written in Japanese, and in the process of deciphering, players will naturally learn the Japanese language. Jewel of Clementia is not a language learning course, but immersive gaming experiences. Instead of someone teaching you Japanese, you will discover how the language works on your own. The game aims to offer a new innovative way of learning a language. The game focuses on puzzle solving so the game is enjoyable even if you are not interested in learning Japanese.

Jewel of Clementia is a visual novel game, but the story progress is non linear. For example, you can practice what you learned whenever you want and each time you successfully complete a practice, you will gain manas. There are many interesting quests in the game and as you take on the quests, you will learn about the world, the Jewel of Clementia, and of course the Japanese language. This game is an ambitious project which incorporates an interesting story and gameplay into language learning. Whether you are interested in learning Japaese or not, the game will surely offer you excellent gaming experiences.
